enabled.label: Enable one-time secrets
enabled.hint: Disabling the module refuses new secrets; existing ones stay readable until they end.

durations.label: Offered durations
durations.hint: How long a secret stays valid from its activation. Check at least one duration.

defaultDuration.label: Default duration
defaultDuration.hint: Preselected at creation. It must be one of the offered durations.

fileAllowed.label: Allow an attached file
fileAllowed.hint: A small file, encrypted in the browser, can go with the text. It is not scanned by the antivirus.

emailAllowed.label: Allow delivery by e-mail
emailAllowed.hint: The server sends the link to a recipient. Otherwise the author hands the link over.

emailRequiresPassphrase.label: Require a passphrase for e-mail delivery
emailRequiresPassphrase.hint: A secret sent by e-mail must be protected by a passphrase, to be passed on through another channel.

errors.defaultNotOffered: Choose a default duration among the offered ones.
errors.fileSize: Enter a size in MiB, from {min} to {max}.

delete.title: Delete this secret?
delete.text: The secret of {creator} will be destroyed and can no longer be read. This cannot be undone.
